title: Z1R Rise Track Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Z1r Rise Track Grey is delivers competition-grade off-road impact absorption with maximum cooling throughput, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1270g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~100 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Youth and budget MX helmet with multi-position visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for dirt/MX riding; Z1R Rise Track Grey features a track-inspired aesthetic with grey accents.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Z1r Z1R Rise Track Grey: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Z1r's Dirt / MX lineup, the Z1R Rise Track Grey brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Z1r Rise Track Grey represents Z1r's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Z1r Rise Track Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
